Welcome, girls. Everything you need for school is on this site.

::: {.this-week}
## Start your day here

1. Open **[This Week's Assignments](weekly.qmd)** and read the whole page before you begin.
2. Go to your own page, [Brailee](brailee.qmd) or [Addy](addy.qmd), for your course links.
3. Work the subjects in the order listed. Check off each one as you finish.
4. Anything you could not finish or did not understand, write it down and bring it to me.
:::

## Daily routine

| Time | What |
|---|---|
| 8:30 | Start. Check the weekly page. |
| 8:45 | Math |
| 9:45 | Writing and Literature |
| 10:45 | Break |
| 11:00 | Science or History |
| 12:00 | Lunch |
| 1:00 | Spanish, electives, catch up work |
| 2:30 | Log your work for the day |

## House rules

- School work happens before screens.
- If you are stuck for more than fifteen minutes, stop and ask. Do not guess your way through a whole lesson.
- Turn in work the same day you finish it.
- Late or missed work gets made up on Friday.

## Grade levels this year

- **Brailee** is in 9th grade. Her work counts toward her high school transcript, so keeping records is part of the job.
- **Addy** is in 7th grade.
